heroHeadline: De la Espriella Bombs Catatumbo Dissident Camp as Air Force Drug-Flight Probe Opens
heroSubtitle: Kfir and Super Tucano aircraft struck a Frente 33 camp between Tibú and El Tarra on October 11, the fourth bombing of his term and the first since a court paused them. The final toll was four dissidents killed, one a 16-year-old girl, and three soldiers hurt by a minefield.
footerNote: Data sourced from the Colombian Truth Commission (CEV), JEP, INDEPAZ, InSight Crime, ICRC, Human Rights Watch, UNODC, MOE (Electoral Observation Mission), Ecopetrol, Registraduría Nacional, and major international outlets.
